lead.headline: No starter in doubt; Pickens plays from the bench
lead.deck: 1-6. 44.1 banked. The lineup is the projection lineup; nothing to do before 12:00.
lead.body: The bad news is on the bench. George Pickens practised limited all week and is still questionable; Schefter reports he is expected to play, but at 14.0 he sits a coin flip behind Tuten in the flex and Wilson at receiver, so the projection keeps him out and no thesis is written. Jonathan Taylor's name is on the trade wire — the Colts are open to moving him before 10 November — but he plays at Jacksonville today. Loveland was cleared Saturday and plays Monday; Pitts locks at noon and stays benched. Jacobs and Golden banked 44.1 on Thursday; ESPN makes it 60%.
